mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.user_id AS userId, p.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, -- DB 컬럼(snake_case) -> DTO 필드(camelCase) u.nickname, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.user_id AS userId
FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.id DESC;
